parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive search across actor name, readable action or action code, event ID and target ID. Embedded action metadata is excluded.

200.description: Activity page; current actor names/roles, with no credential fields or raw embedded audit metadata

googlePlaceId.description: Persisted matched Google Place ID only. Google photo content is transient.

nights.description: Inclusive travel days minus one; a selected overnight stay on a one-day trip uses one night.

travelStyle.description: Historical saved metadata is preserved. New and regenerated itineraries use balanced; this is not a selectable input.

pace.description: Historical saved pacing is preserved on read. New and regenerated itineraries use balanced pacing.

ItineraryGenerationRequest.description: Both dates count as travel days. End date must be between start date and start date plus 30 calendar days. Costs refer to the whole party's ONE trip budget.

scheduleConstraints.description: Optional destination-local clocks. Arrival reserves 90 minutes; departure reserves 120 minutes. Rest dates intentionally omit sightseeing.

days.description: Exactly one entry for every selected date, inclusive, with no gaps.

completedAt.description: When the traveler marked this trip as done. Retained when archived.

selectedAccommodation.description: Small selected-stay summary available without loading the full itinerary; no booking or current availability claim.

itinerary.description: Versioned snapshot envelope with original trip context. History listings return null; snapshot content is read only during restoration.

notificationsUnreadCount.description: Total unread notifications for the signed-in admin, including older records outside the latest 50.

token.description: Signed owner/trip/revision-bound proposal; expires after 15 minutes

x-visited-place-actions.record: record-visit: tripId/dayIndex/activityIndex or name/destination, visitDate, timeZone
x-visited-place-actions.remove: remove-visit: id; only the current owner may remove a visit

x-trip-save-idempotency: save-trip accepts saveKey (8–100 safe characters); otherwise uses a canonical content hash. Keys are unique per user, tied to payloads, and replay the original saved trip. The duplicate-trip action has been removed.

x-visited-places.recordTripPlaces: record-trip-visits: tripId, places[{key,fingerprint}], actual visitDate and timeZone. Atomic, deduplicated across previous dates; never changes trip status.
